resources.string: MISSION DISPATCH: THE BROKEN SUPPLY ROUTE

A vital medical supply convoy has been ambushed in the borderlands. Communications are silenced, and an injured courier barely made it to the outpost.\n\nFive shinobi must escort the remaining supplies to the front-line field clinic through hostile territory. Squad positioning, threat assessment, and counter-tactics will determine survival.
